title: Tiny, cute house
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#2f6b3a'/>
  <!-- house body -->
  <rect x='30' y='48' width='40' height='34' rx='2' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <rect x='30' y='48' width='40' height='6' fill='#f2c98a'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='44' y='62' width='12' height='20' rx='2' fill='#8a4b2a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='73' r='1.6' fill='#ffd75e'/>
  <!-- windows -->
  <rect x='34' y='56' width='8' height='8' rx='1' fill='#7fd3ff'/>
  <rect x='58' y='56' width='8' height='8' rx='1' fill='#7fd3ff'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='56' x2='38' y2='64' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='60' x2='42' y2='60' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='56' x2='62' y2='64' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='60' x2='66' y2='60' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points='27,49 50,28 73,49' fill='#e0574f'/>
  <polygon points='27,49 50,28 50,49' fill='#f07a72'/>
  <!-- chimney -->
  <rect x='58' y='30' width='7' height='14' rx='1' fill='#c9b39a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='30' width='7' height='3' fill='#e0ceb8'/>
  <!-- smoke -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='24' r='2.6' fill='#cfe0ea'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='18' r='2' fill='#cfe0ea'/>
  <!-- door step -->
  <rect x='42' y='81' width='16' height='3' rx='1' fill='#c9b39a'/>
</svg>
